author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad (k=320, p=40): Larger Factor Capacity + Curvature
abstract: Scale factor capacity to k=320 with factorized loadings L=U@V^T and projection rank p=40 to test if increased factor diversity improves MAE. Uses oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors, input-adaptive temporal gating, global horizon gating, residual copy head, and MAE+curvature loss.
